source_caption_text:
Yung Miami links up with Travis Scott on her debut solo album, Watch Dis!, for the J White Did It-produced track "Just Might Go." 🔥

She tells XXL the collab came together after the Don Toliver concert back in June.

"I did the Don Toliver concert in L.A," she says. "He brought me out. I just love my music so much. I wanted to go to the studio to listen to my music. I went to the studio... and I was listening to ['Just Might Go']. Travis end up pulling up... We did the studio together in real time."

What's your favorite track on Yung Miami's new album? 🤔
